notes: P02 independent per-case truth oracle for RQ1-RQ3 (Replay-Closed Authorization Across Purpose, Delegation, and AI Proposal Lineage). independent_oracle.py DELEGATES all decision logic to the shared audited kernel evaluation.venue2027._shared.oracle_kernel.adjudicate (ORACLE_KERNEL_VERSION 1.0.0) with a module-local DECLARATIVE IFIP reference rule table IFIP_REFERENCE_RULES frozen against CASE_MATRIX.md: fresh_accept->ADMIT (CASE-01), cross_purpose_replay->REJECT (CASE-02), delegation_replay->REJECT (consumed-once invariant), lineage_splice->REJECT (provenance binding). Any family outside the table returns INDETERMINATE via kernel UNMODELLED_FAMILY (e.g. CASE-08 key rotation, DECIDE_BY_SPEC), and an undeclared family returns INDETERMINATE via NO_FAMILY_DECLARED - never a silent safe verdict. ORACLE_ID='ifip-sec-reference'; entry point adjudicate(case)->OracleResult (kernel OracleResult, JSON-serializable via to_dict, evidence uris captured verbatim); missing case_id raises OracleError MISSING_CASE_ID (wiring error, not an outcome). INDEPENDENCE (GATES/INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE_PROTOCOL.md item 2): the module does NOT import the IFIP baselines/candidate - no import of evaluation.venue2027.ifip_sec.baselines, consistency_token_adapter or any candidate mechanism; verify_independence() scans this module's own source with ast and refuses any import of the candidate modules listed in CANDIDATE_MODULE_NAMES ('ifip_sec.baselines', 'ifip_sec.consistency_token_adapter', 'baselines', 'consistency_token_adapter') with stable reason code CANDIDATE_IMPORT - covering plain/aliased/from-imports and dotted paths (matched per dotted component on the candidate basenames, so the oracle's own package path and look-alike modules like my_baseline_labels do not trip it), and dynamic imports (__import__/importlib.import_module) flagged as the __dynamic__ sentinel for review rather than guessed safe. test_independent_oracle.py imports only the oracle (plus the shared kernel): 5 positive controls (fresh-accept admit with evidence capture, 3 reject families, unknown/undeclared/payload-family INDETERMINATE, MISSING_CASE_ID refusal, determinism + JSON round-trip + rule-table freeze + built-in self-checks) and 17 adversarial controls (clean live source passes, 10 candidate-import variants refused, unrelated-import acceptance, __import__/importlib dynamic flags, temp on-disk rogue oracle importing the candidate refused by the kernel AST guard assert_oracle_independence, tampered live-source control). 22 passed in 0.28s (full ifip_sec evaluation suite 75 passed); uvx ruff@0.7.1 check + format --check clean; source_sha_after records the base commit e5f7ee3b per sibling convention (COMPSAC-X02_closure_oracle); the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and reported in the handoff. oracle_disagreement_count null (no candidate-vs-oracle comparison run in this task; the candidate does not exist yet - IFIP_SEC-candidate depends on this oracle).
